Key features: Persistent staged runs – pass output_dir save run artifacts completed stage; pass resume = TRUE load saved artifacts skip completed stages. ToC-enriched perspective discovery – seed URLs fetched table--contents headings extracted give coordinator richer context generating expert perspectives. Parallel section writing – pass parallel_writing = TRUE write report sections concurrently mirai, extract facts assemble article deterministic outline order. dsprrr modules – structured extraction steps (query decomposition, fact extraction, outline drafting, section writing) use dsprrr modules reliable structured output.
